name: Communication
sub: Announcements by email, direct messages, and one calendar for the whole program.
get: Announcements go out by email, with notifications on families' phones, and you can schedule them for Sunday night.
Direct messages keep staff and family conversations in threads. One program calendar imports your Google Calendar and gives families feeds they can add to their own phones.
cta: See what your families would receive.

faq.a: Delivery tracking flags it, so you can fix the address.

steps.body: Write it once and choose who it's for: everyone, an ensemble or a handful of families. Send it now or schedule it for later.
